title: Praeculus Eternium
description: Optimization Modpack for Praeculus Eternium. Features UI, performance, and voice chat mods to improve the vanilla experience.
body:
# Includes the Following:
1. **AppleSkin** => (Animation): Display how muhc hunger and saturation a food will give you before you eat it
2. **Clumps** => (Performance mod): Clumps XP orbs together more effeciently to improve performance
3. **CreativeCore** => (Dependency):  For FerriteCore
4. **Entity Culling** => (Performance mod): Using async path-tracing to hide Tiles/Entities that are not visible
5. **FerriteCore** => (Performance mod): Optimizes memory usage
6. **ImmediatlyFast** =>(Performance mod): Speeds up immediete rendering mode
7. **Mouse Tweaks** => (Functionality): Allows for better inventory management by adding more funcations to the mouse
8. **Not Enough Animations** => (Animation): Adds the first-person animations to 3rd person
9. **Shulker Box Tooltip** => (Animation): Allows for hovering over shulker boxes in inventory to display their contents
10. **Simple Voice Chat** => (Functionality): Allows proximity voice chat
11. **Sodium** => (Performance mod): Powerful Performance mod that replaces the video settings section in minecraft
12. **Fabric API** => (Dependency): For Fabric modpacks
13. **BetterF3** (_Feature_) => Cleans up the F3 menu
14. **Client Crafting** (_Performance_) => Fixes issue of delayed crafty due to server lag
15. **Client Sort** (_Feature_) => Adds buttons in inventory screen to quick sort your inventory or chest / interacting storage item
16. **Crash Assistant** (_Feature_) => Adds smoother debugging in the event of a crash
17. **Dynamic FPS** (_Performance_) => Improves performance when Minecraft is running in the background
18. **Mod Menu** (_Feature_) => Adds a new menu option for viewing your mods
19. **Simple Voice Chat Enhanced groups** (_Feature_) => Add Group calls as opposed to just proximity chat
20. **Skin Layer 3D** (_Feature_) => Renders player skins in 3d for a cleaner look
21. **Sound Control & Manager** (_Feature_) => Allows for custom control over the volume of every sound in minecraft.
